samples.summary: New docs `setImageUrlResolver` seam has no test, unlike the identical seams in slides and notes
samples.evidence: `packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts:33-57` adds a resolver applied inside `getOrLoadImage` (and used as the cache key). No docs test references it: `grep image-cache|getOrLoadImage packages/docs/test` returns nothing, and `grep setImageUrlResolver` finds tests only for slides (`packages/slides/test/view/canvas/image-cache-resolver.test.ts`), notes (`packages/notes/src/view/preview-image-resolver.test.ts`) and sheets (`packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/image-cache.test.ts`). The slides test pins exactly the properties left untested here — fetches the resolved URL not the logical src, identity by default, `null` restores identity, cache keyed by resolved URL. If this regresses, every share-link-uploaded image 403s and silently fails to render for all readers (issue #1037's symptom), with nothing to catch it.

samples.summary: `postShareTokenImage` (plain fetch, not fetchWithAuth) and the new `failureText` JSON unwrapping are untested
samples.evidence: The whole point of the fix is that the anonymous upload must NOT go through `fetchWithAuth` (whose 401/403 path calls `logout()` and navigates to `/login`, ejecting the visitor). Nothing pins that: `packages/frontend/src/api/` contains analytics/documents/ndjson/miro/share-image-url/url/download-file tests but no `images.test.ts` (glob `packages/frontend/src/api/*.test.ts*`), and no file other than images.ts mentions `postShareTokenImage` (grep). A future refactor swapping `fetch` back to `fetchWithAuth`, or dropping `{ authenticated: false }`, reintroduces the exact user-visible logout-and-lose-the-document bug with a green suite. Likewise `failureText` (images.ts:134) — the JSON `message` extraction vs raw-body fallback that decides what the toast shows — has no test.

samples.summary: The new unauthenticated route's Multer size limit and MIME `fileFilter` are never exercised — the spec instantiates the controller directly, bypassing interceptors
samples.evidence: `image-share-upload.controller.spec.ts` builds the controller with `new ApiV1ShareImageUploadController(...)` and calls `ctrl.upload(...)` directly, so `FileInterceptor`'s `limits.fileSize` and `fileFilter` (controller lines 74-89) never run. The sibling route sets the standard: `packages/backend/src/api/v1/images.controller.spec.ts:50-121` boots a Nest app with supertest and asserts 413 at cap+1, 201 at exactly cap, 400 with the literal `Unsupported file type: image/svg+xml`, and acceptance of each allowlisted type. Since this is the only *unauthenticated* write in the image module, a wrong constant or a filter that calls `cb(null, true)` unconditionally would let oversized/unsupported bodies through undetected.

samples.summary: No test that `insertImageFromFile` uses the injected uploader (or defaults to the owner one), nor that `shareTokenImageUploader` resolves the returned URL
samples.evidence: `insertImageFromFile` gained an `upload: DocsImageUpload = uploadImageFile` parameter and every call site in the diff (docs-view.tsx:487, docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:279/898) now threads it. There is no test directory for these: `glob packages/frontend/src/app/docs/*.test.*` returns nothing, and grep for `insertImageFromFile`/`shareTokenImageUploader` finds only source files. A wiring mistake (e.g. passing the position argument in the uploader slot, or dropping `uploadImageRef.current`) silently reverts anonymous editors to the 401/logout path.

samples.summary: Adding `"doc"` to IMAGE_RESOLVER_INSTALLERS (and the claim that the child's passive effect runs after this layout effect) is untested
samples.evidence: `shared-document.tsx` has no test file (`glob packages/frontend/src/app/shared/*.test.*` → none). The new `["doc", setDocsImageUrlResolver]` entry plus the ordering argument documented at shared-document.tsx:888-898 (resolver installed before DocsView's passive-effect canvas creation) is exactly the kind of ordering assumption that breaks silently — an un-tokened first fetch 403s and the image never appears. The other engines' entries are equally untested, so this is pre-existing shape rather than new debt, but the doc path is the one this change ships.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. packages/docs/src/view/image-cache.ts:33-57 adds a module-level urlResolver, setImageUrlResolver, and applies it inside getOrLoadImage (line 57), with the image cache and pending-callback maps keyed by the resolved URL (lines 58, 65-68, 76, 83). A paged repo-wide grep for getOrLoadImage/image-cache/imageUrlResolver/setImageUrlResolver returns test files only for slides (packages/slides/test/view/canvas/image-cache-resolver.test.ts), notes (packages/notes/src/view/preview-image-resolver.test.ts) and sheets (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/image-cache.test.ts) — no test anywhere references the docs module. I also checked all 109 packages/docs/**/*.test.ts files, colocated src/*.test.ts (the layout notes uses), packages/frontend/src/app/shared/__tests__/shared-blob-routing.test.ts (only asserts sharedBlobKind), the frontend e2e/tests dir, scripts/verify-self.mjs, and the IMAGE_RESOLVER_INSTALLERS map (shared-document.tsx:861-904, doc entry at :877) — none is covered by a test. The nearest coverage, packages/frontend/src/api/share-image-url.test.ts, exercises the pure appendShareTokenToImageUrl rewriter, so it would still pass if the docs seam never applied the resolver or keyed the cache by the logical src instead of the resolved URL. This is a new behavior on a user-facing path (share-link image rendering for all readers, per docs/tasks/active/20260907-share-link-image-upload-todo.md:42-44,56-57) whose failure mode is a silent non-render, so the missing test is blocking-major under the test-adequacy rubric. Found no counterexample.

verdict.reason: Verified the absence independently and widely. `postShareTokenImage` (images.ts:51-62) routes through the new `authenticated: false` branch of `post()` (images.ts:117-120, plain `fetch` + `credentials: "include"`), and `failureText` (images.ts:134-143) is new error-message logic. No test in the repo imports `@/api/images`: repo-wide grep for `api/images` yields only source and docs files. I searched beyond the reviewer's globs — the second test tree `packages/frontend/tests/**` (tests/api/{files,lakehouse,single-flight,http-error}.test.ts, tests/app/docs/*), `src/app/shared/__tests__/`, `**/*.spec.ts` under frontend (none), and any e2e suite (none) — and found no coverage of either behavior. Grep for `shareTokenImageUploader|insertImageFromFile` returns only source files, so the caller path is untested too. The closest test, spreadsheet/image-upload.test.ts, mocks `fetchWithAuth` and exercises only the authenticated `postWorkspaceImage` branch with `ok: true`, so it would remain green if `postShareTokenImage` were swapped back to `fetchWithAuth`, and it never enters `failureText`. Backend specs (image-share-upload.controller.spec.ts) cover the server route only and cannot pin the frontend's client choice. Blocking as major: the untested guarantee is that an anonymous editor-link visitor is not logged out and ejected from the document on a legitimate 403 — a user-visible, work-losing regression that would ship with a green suite.
